title: Cakeyeater's Enchantment Archive
description: Custom enchantments and overhaul the tool repair system
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/WFzOu4gA3OU" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

This datapack adds 31 new enchantments, two new mechanics, and modifies several items

<details>
<summary> Enchantment names and abilities </summary>
  
**Non-Curses:**
 - Fortifying: Increased max health
 - Magic Protection: Adds damage protection to sources of magic damage (potion effects, the Wither, dragon's breath attack)
- Fire Eater: Increases damage against entities on fire, then extinguishes the flame
- Vampiric Critical: Heal on crit
- Blinding Strike: Chance to inflict blindness and slowness
- Enfeebling Strike: Chance to inflict weakness IV, slowness IV, and mining fatigue IV
- Venom Strike: Chance to inflict poison, weakness, and slowness
- Husk Strike: Chance to inflict hunger III
- Necrotic Strike: Chance to inflict wither
- Shulker Strike: Chance to inflict levitation
- Air Braking: Reduced kinetic damage from elytra flight
- Long Tool Handle: Increases block reach for tools by 2 blocks
- Reaching: Increase weapon reach by 1.5 blocks
- Puncturing: Tridents ignore armor
- Moonwalker: Reduced gravity and fall damage
- Auto Smelt: Mining ores, debris, sand, or logs produces ingots, scrap, glass, and charcoal
- Nether's Might: Increased attack damage while in the Nether
- End's Toughness: Increased armor toughness while in the End

**Animal Armor Enchantments**
- Freezing Immunity: Grants immunity to damage from powder snow
- Fire Immunity: Grants immunity to fire and lava
- Magic Immunity: Grants immunity to potions of harming, poison, and wither effects
- Fall Damage Immunity: Grants immunity to fall damage (even on dripstone)
- Projectile Immunity: Grants immunity to damage from all projectiles
- Explosion Immunity: Grants immunity to damage from all explosions
- Combat Immunity: Grants immunity to all damage dealt by players in survival

**Curses:**
- Curse of Shrinking: Your size is halved, and your step height, jump height, and interaction range are reduced
- Unstable: 5% chance to explode when another entity damages you
- Curse of Infested Strike: Chance to inflict infested effect
- Curse of Oozing Strike: Chance to inflict oozing effect
- Curse of Weaving Strike: Chance to inflict weaving effect
- Curse of Wind Charged Strike: Chance to inflict wind charged effect



</details>



**Advancement Rewards:** 5 advancements have been modified, and 1 new advancement added, to reward players with legendary enchantments Nether's might and End's toughness. Both grant stat bonuses in their respective dimensions.

**Repair Kit:** To help players make use of the new enchantments, and to make repairing more viable, a new item has been added: repair kits.
Crafted using leather, string, iron, and honeycomb, the repair kit is a consumable item that resets the repair/enchant cost of items held in the offhand. This allows you to bypass the "Too Expensive" warning in the anvil by resetting the cost accrued by using the anvil. This feature requires the attached resource pack to use.

**Additional Changes:**
Modifies wolf armor and horse armor to be enchantable in enchanting tables.
Tridents are modified to be repairable with prismarine shards
Bows, crossbows, and fishing rods are modified to be repairable with sticks


<details>
<summary>Treasure only enchantments and their locations</summary>
  
- Puncturing: Buried treasure
- Auto Smelt: Bastion remnants
- Moonwalker: End cities
- Nether's Might: Complete the special Nether advancement "Champion of the Nether" or "How did we get here?"
- End's Toughness: Complete any goal advancement in the End tab e.g. "Sky's the Limit"
